name: trio_ground_key
desc: Clean this rough into finished pixel art without changing the layout: a sticky sandwich on the floor. The pink goo crocodile lies underneath on its back holding the small black witch cat from below; the huge pink goo Doberman lies on top, pressing down and wrapping both thick arms around the cat and the crocodile, rubbing its broad chest on the cat. All three glued together with thick, stretchy pink goo strands and dripping paint; the cat squashed in the middle, struggling. Keep both monsters' designs, colors, yellow marble streaks, and the cat's design. Transparent background.
